metadata.title: डोंगारिया कौंध शॉल को मिलेगा GI Tag| Dongriya Kondh Shawl to get GI tag | Rayagada odisha
metadata.description:
The Kapdaganda shawl is a true testament to the rich cultural heritage and exceptional craftsmanship of the Dongriya Kondh, a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) residing in the Rayagada district of Odisha, India. These exquisite handwoven shawls have recently acquired the prestigious Geographical Indication (GI) tag, highlighting their unique and cherished status.

Kapdaganda shawls are a marvel of traditional weaving and embroidery techniques passed down through generations. Each shawl is meticulously handwoven, showcasing the tribe's remarkable skills in creating intricate patterns and designs. The shawls are made from fine-quality fabrics, and their distinctiveness lies in the beautiful and elaborate embroidery that adorns them.

These shawls hold a special place in Dongriya Kondh culture and tradition. They are not just pieces of clothing but rather symbols of gratitude, representing the tribe's appreciation for the natural resources and environment that sustain their way of life. Kapdaganda shawls also serve as a testament to the Dongriya Kondh's dedication to preserving and celebrating their heritage.

With the acquisition of the GI tag, Kapdaganda shawls have gained national and international recognition as a unique and valuable cultural artifact. They are not only a source of pride for the Dongriya Kondh community but also a beautiful representation of traditional craftsmanship at its finest, showcasing the remarkable skills and artistry of this indigenous tribal group.
